entities.name: Taíno Chiefdoms and Cacicazgos
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Taíno people, part of the Arawak language family, migrated from the Orinoco delta and established sophisticated agricultural societies with complex political structures organized into cacicazgos (chiefdoms) governed by caciques.
